```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
figs <- c(stat_html("Citations", num$citations, "in"),
          stat_html("Peer-reviewed articles", num$articles, "te"),
          stat_html("Open-source packages", num$software, "ma"))
figs <- figs[nzchar(figs)]
if (length(figs))
  cat("```{=html}\n<section class=\"hm-figs\" aria-label=\"Key figures\">\n",
      paste(figs, collapse = "\n"), "\n</section>\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# Honours on Home: a short selection from the `awards` tab of the Google Sheet,
# through the same cleaning step as the About page and the CV (awards_clean in
# R/site-data.R). A row shows here when its cell in the column `home` holds a
# mark (an x, or a ticked box). With no mark at all, the three newest show.
# The rows are the same block as on About, with the same links to the certificate
# and the photo (award_rows_html in R/site-data.R). A link to a picture opens in
# the picture viewer on this page (data-lb, script in _theme/site.html). The link
# under the list leads to the full list on About.
a <- site_awards()
h <- awards_home(a)
if (!is.null(h) && nrow(h) > 0) {
  rows <- award_rows_html(h, up = "", indent = "      ")                      # "": Home is at the project root
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    '```{=html}\n',
    '  <section class="hm-sec hue-in" id="honours">\n',
    '    <div class="hm-sec__line"><h2>Honours</h2><span>%s</span></div>\n',
    '    <div class="pg-rows pg-rows--dated">\n%s\n    </div>\n',
    '    <div class="pg-links"><a class="tl" href="about/index.html#honours">All %d honours',
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17L17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg></a></div>\n',
    '  </section>\n',
    '```\n'),
    if (nrow(h) < nrow(a)) "Selected" else "", paste(rows, collapse = "\n"), nrow(a)))
}
```
